result: {"lens":"correctness","summary":"024B review covers scaffold-downstream.sh, adopter-wrapper.yml.tmpl, enable-required-check.sh --restore, check-invocation-log-entry.sh + its CI workflow, both test suites, ADOPT-001 §12.8, D-044, and STATUS.md. Production code paths are sound: cascade-status regex uses Python re.search (correct for (?:...) and \\S), per-slug TF regex specialization is intentionally stricter than the general spec, --restore mode correctly skips the forward-mode safety check, ADOPT-001 §12.8 names all 4 required references plus the <30 min SLO, D-044 covers all components with the correct date and ACCEPTED status, and STATUS.md is correctly positioned. Two MAJ issues were found. First: the scaffolder test suite leaks temporary output directories into the repo root — make_output_dir() creates dirs at ${REPO_ROOT}/out.XXXXXX but the cleanup trap removes only $TMPDIR, leaving those dirs untracked; the conversation git status confirms 4 orphaned out.* entries. Second: the CI workflow check-invocation-log-entry.yml will fail-closed on the 024B PR itself — the DISPATCH-NOTE uses backtick-formatted text that gives 0 Python regex matches for cascade-status, triggering the fail-closed exit path with no exemption for the scaffolding slice. Three MIN issues: (1) the CI workflow uses three-dot syntax to discover DISPATCH-NOTE paths but then calls the script with --diff-base (two-dot), producing subtly different commit sets on non-fast-forward merge-bases; (2) the awk DISPATCH-NOTE picker silently uses the last match if multiple DISPATCH-NOTE.md files are added in one PR; (3) the PR-mode test cases (case16/17) only exercise cascade-status=onboarded, leaving operator-bump and conflict-close paths untested in --pr mode. One nit: the CI workflow grants pull-requests: read which is unused in --diff-base invocation.","findings":[{"id":"MAJ-CORR-001","severity":"MAJ","claim":"Scaffolder test suite leaks output directories into the repo root on every run.","evidence":"tests/scaffolder/test_scaffold_downstream.sh:100 — make_output_dir() calls mktemp -d \"${REPO_ROOT}/out.XXXXXX\"; cleanup trap at lines 10-13 removes only $TMPDIR. On a branch whose merge-base differs from origin/main HEAD, the file list and the patch can diverge.","impact":"The workflow may detect a DISPATCH-NOTE that the script's diff does not include (or vice versa), causing a spurious skip or an unexpected fail-closed for legitimate PRs on stale branches.","mitigation":"Align both to three-dot syntax: pass --diff-base $(git merge-base HEAD origin/main) to the script, or use git diff origin/main...HEAD uniformly throughout."},{"id":"MIN-CORR-002","severity":"MIN","claim":"awk DISPATCH-NOTE picker silently uses the last match when multiple DISPATCH-NOTE.md files appear in a single PR.","evidence":".github/workflows/check-invocation-log-entry.yml: awk '/\\/DISPATCH-NOTE\\.md$/{last=$0} END{print last}' — if two adopter slices are batched into one PR, only the last DISPATCH-NOTE is checked; the first is silently ignored.","impact":"A batched PR containing two cascade slices would pass CI with only one slice's invariants verified, providing false assurance about the second slice.","mitigation":"Fail explicitly when the awk match count is >1: awk 'END{if(n!=1){exit 1}} /DISPATCH-NOTE/{n++;last=$0} END{print last}', or document in plan-doc §6 that each cascade slice must be a separate PR."},{"id":"MIN-CORR-003","severity":"MIN","claim":"PR-mode test cases do not cover operator-bump or conflict-close cascade-status branches.","evidence":"tests/check_invocation_log/test_check_invocation_log_entry.sh case16 and case17 both use cascade-status=onboarded. No case exercises --pr with onboarded-operator-bump (which additionally requires STATUS.md TF row) or blocked-on-adopter-conflict (which requires TF-024X-conflict reference in DISPATCH-NOTE) via the gh-based code path.","impact":"The gh pr diff / gh pr view code path in check-invocation-log-entry.sh:160-163 is untested for two of the three valid cascade-status values; regressions introduced in those branches would not be caught by CI.","mitigation":"Add mock-gh test cases for operator-bump and conflict-close under --pr mode, using a gh stub that echoes fixture patch content, matching the pattern used by existing PR-mode cases."},{"id":"nit-CORR-001","severity":"nit","claim":"CI workflow grants pull-requests: read permission that is unused in --diff-base invocation mode.","evidence":".github/workflows/check-invocation-log-entry.yml permissions block includes pull-requests: read; the workflow calls the script with --diff-base origin/main, never --pr, so gh pr view/diff are never invoked and pull-requests: read is dead.","impact":"Violates least-privilege posture established by the wrapper template (contents: read + statuses: write only); presents a misleading affordance suggesting PR API is in scope.","mitigation":"Remove pull-requests: read from the workflow permissions block.
